Intents in PR stacks should always be in a specific branch that is easy to stack with other branches and easy to continue work on; past sessions always messed this up.

Decision (user, AskUserQuestion): Intent state lives on one dedicated state-only branch (e.g. holyagent/state) in a persistent linked worktree; every holyagent command reads and writes there from any branch or worktree; Intents record their stack branches and PRs; work branches and PRs stop carrying .holyagent/.
